blocks.text: You can view registered domains with Zscaler Authentication Service and add guest domains to allow third-party users (guest users) to access the Zscaler service.
For example, if @vibelift.com is a registered domain and @partnerfirm.com is a guest domain, the user login flow is as follows:

blocks.item: Registered Domain: If a user with the @vibelift.com domain in their email address logs in, the Authentication Service recognizes the domain and redirects them to the identity provider (IdP) associated with that domain for authentication.

Guest Domain: If a user with the @partnerfirm.com domain in their email address logs in, the Authentication Service redirects them to their own company's sign-in page for authentication. On successful authentication, guest domain users can access Zscaler services shared with registered domains without requiring a VibeLift account.
Arbitrary Guest Domain: If a user with any other domain (e.g., @dbhelper.net) in their email address tries to log in:

If the Arbitrary Guest Domain toggle is enabled, the Authentication Service allows them to authenticate through a one-time passcode (OTP) sent to their email without requiring an administrator to manually pre-register their domain first.
If the Arbitrary Guest Domain toggle is disabled, the login request is immediately denied.
Registered domain users must have the Zscaler Client Connector app installed on their devices to log in.
Guest domains can be assigned to users who do not have Zscaler Client Connector. They log in via web browser.
Arbitrary Guest Domains are supported only with Privileged Remote Access (PRA). The Zscaler Client Connector app is not supported for these domains.

blocks.text: The domains provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: View registered domains and their associated IdPs.
Redirect users to the IdP or tenant based on the domain used in their login email.

blocks.text: On the Domains page (Administration > Authentication > Domains), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Click Edit to add guest domains.
Refresh the Domains List table to sync new data.
Modify the columns displayed in the table.
View registered domain list and associated IdP.
View the list of guest domains.
View the status of Arbitrary Guest Domains (Enabled or Disabled).
